definitions.explanation: The process of becoming hard or rigid. Used for physical materials (concrete, adhesives) and medical conditions (arteries, tissue).

examples.japanese: セメントが{硬化|こうか}した。
{動脈|どうみゃく}{硬化|こうか}は{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}{病|びょう}のひとつだ。
examples.english: Arteriosclerosis is one of the lifestyle-related diseases.

examples.japanese: {接着|せっちゃく}{剤|ざい}が{完全|かんぜん}に{硬化|こうか}するまで{二十四|にじゅうよ}{時間|じかん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes twenty-four hours for the adhesive to fully harden.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in both technical/industrial and medical contexts. In medicine, {動脈|どうみゃく}{硬化|こうか} (arteriosclerosis) is the most well-known compound. In manufacturing and construction, it refers to the curing or hardening of materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動脈|どうみゃく}{硬化|こうか}: arteriosclerosis
- {硬化|こうか}{剤|ざい}: hardening agent, curing agent
- {硬化|こうか}コンクリート: hardened concrete
- {表面|ひょうめん}{硬化|こうか}: surface hardening
